review: Whole image and both halves read personally line by line. All formula blanks, bars, subscripts and six objects checked; there are no drawn arrows in the upper array. Enlarged every deletion, the marginal mark and the right-edge insertion, plus mathematical lines. The surprising x product letter, X=Y (bar X), ennparticulier, désignantt, homomorhisme, lower-case or and the question mark after the parenthetic NB are retained. H has nothing for this page.
